# Day 39 - PDF Splitter & Merger

## Overview

For Day 39 of the AI Challenge, I developed an interactive **PDF Splitter & Merger** application that helps users manage PDF documents through simple browser-based operations.

The application allows users to split PDF files into smaller parts, merge multiple PDFs into a single document, preview processed files, and download the final output.

## Features Implemented

* AI-guided onboarding experience
* PDF splitting functionality
* PDF merging functionality
* Processed PDF preview
* Download option for generated files
* User-friendly document management workflow

## Technologies Used

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* AI-assisted development using Claude

## Learning Outcomes

* Learned how AI can assist in building practical utility applications
* Explored browser-based file processing concepts
* Understood PDF manipulation workflows
* Improved skills in creating interactive web tools
* Learned the importance of user experience in productivity applications

## Conclusion

This project demonstrated how AI-powered development can help create useful productivity tools that automate common tasks and improve digital workflows.
